thread:
alex: Hey — doing the Node quickstart and my first request keeps failing with a timeout/401 combo. quickstart steps: set REDWOOD_API_KEY, npm install @redwood/inference, run example.

alex: Error output: 
```
Error: Request failed with status code 401
 at createError (...)
 at settle (...)
 at IncomingMessage.handleStreamEnd (...)
```

alex: Also seeing a weird line in logs: "billing: workspace suspended - billing required" but I thought trial workspaces could call hosted API?

jordan: hmm. can you paste the exact curl you ran and the node snippet?

alex: curl I ran: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hi"}'`

alex: node snippet: 
```
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY);
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', input: 'hello' });
console.log(res);
```

jordan: ok that looks fine. 401 + billing message suggests the API is rejecting calls for that workspace. are you on a corp Google account by any chance? we recently block calls when GCP billing not linked for org-owned workspaces.

maya: @alex can you run `redwood workspace status` in the CLI? should show billing state.

alex: ran it — output: `workspace: rdx-dev (id: ws_123) status: active trial expires: 2026-04-02 billing: not configured`

alex: so that explains it? weird UX though, quickstart didn't warn me before the first request.

jordan: yeah that's a DX gap. quickstart used to warn if billing required. filing a short fix to surface billing state earlier in the flow. created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/412

billing-bot: Automated message: Workspace ws_123 flagged as "billing_required". To enable hosted API, link a billing method in the Console -> Billing.

alex: after linking a card in Console the same curl worked immediately. first successful call! :tada:

alex: one more oddity: Node SDK timed out on retry 1 and then threw 401 instead of retrying on a transient 5xx. any recommended retry config?

jordan: default SDK retries are conservative. open to changing. can you share SDK logs (`DEBUG=redwood:* node app.js`)?

alex: will do and drop logs in the issue. thanks all.

devex-bot: Note: follow-up PR proposed to add a billing check in `npx redwood quickstart` and a clearer error message for API responses when billing is the root cause.

maya: great — also adding a sentence to the quickstart README about billing gating and common 401 state.

alex: thanks team, unblocked and first call succeeded. saved me from a tomato can of frustration :slightly_smiling_face:
